Additional style information for certain block kinds.  For example, CODE blocks may have the programming language

title:
A table block, which contains rows and columns and optionally a heading row.
The heading row has a separate element here, but the body rows are in {@link DocumentationBlock#blocks}.

Authoring tables follows the
[GitHub markdown extensions](https://guides.github.com/features/mastering-markdown/#GitHub-flavored-markdown).
A table always has a single header row and zero or more data rows.  The second line must be a separator
between the header and data rows.

For example:

```
| Type     | Legs | Shape       | Leaves |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- | ------ |
| dining   |    4 | rectangular |      3 |
| kitchen  |    4 | oval        |      0 |
| gateleg  |    4 | rectangular |      2 |
| pedestal |    1 | round       |      0 |
```

Renders as:

| Type     | Legs | Shape       | Leaves |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- | ------ |
| dining   |    4 | rectangular |      3 |
| kitchen  |    4 | oval        |      0 |
| gateleg  |    4 | rectangular |      2 |
| pedestal |    1 | round       |      0 |

The table need not be aligned with spaces and the leading and trailing pipe symbols are optional:

```
Type|Legs|Shape|Leaves
-|-|-|-
dining|4|rectangular|3
kitchen|4|oval|0
gateleg|4|rectangular|2
pedestal|1|round|0
```

Explicit column alignment may be specified in the header separator line by using colons:

```
|Type|Legs|Shape|Leaves|
|-|-:|-|-:|
```

Renders as:

|Type|Legs|Shape|Leaves|
|-|-:|-|-:|
|dining|4|rectangular|3|
|kitchen|4|oval|0|
|gateleg|4|rectangular|2|
|pedestal|1|round|0|
